results.content: Equipment available may include the following: • Utility cart • Blood collection trays • Gloves • Blood collection system with safety features (needles and holders or needles with holders) integrated) • Blood collection tubes (a full range of tubes with different volumes within the expiry date) • Tourniquet (preferably disposable) • Antiseptics to clean the puncture site • Dressings • Bandages • Container for needles and sharps • Sample mixer • Watertight carrying bags 3.6 All required materials should be prepared before venous blood collection and for the required tests. These records include, but are not limited to the following: • Identification of an applicant, i.e., a person authorized (under national law) to apply for a blood test • Full name of the patient • Date of birth of the patient • Patient’s address (home address or hospital ward) • Unique sample identification number • Date and time of collection • Identification of the operator performing the sampling 4.4 A minimum of two independent identifiers (patient’s full name and date of birth) and preferably three (the two above plus one additional) should be used to identify the tube.
